title: Sovun sotuvchisi sovg'a qilgan narsa biznesga aylandi...

scenes.text: 1891 yilda bir yosh sotuvchi cho'ntagida 32 dollar bilan Chikagoga keldi.
U sovun sotardi. Xaridor ko'paysin deb, har bir xaridga sovg'a qilib pishiriq kukuni berdi.
Kukun sovundan yaxshiroq sotildi. U kukun sotishga o'tdi va endi sovg'aga saqich qo'sha boshladi.
Bu odam Uilyam Rigli kichik edi. Tez orada xaridorlar ko'proq saqichni so'ray boshladi.
1893 yilda Juicy Fruit va Spearmint chiqdi. Sovg'a uchun olingan saqich uning asosiy biznesiga aylandi.

description:
Uilyam Rigli kichik 1891 yilda 32 dollar bilan Chikagoga kelib, sovun sotgan. Sovg'a qilingan pishiriq kukuni yaxshiroq sotilgach, kukunga o'tgan, keyin sovg'a qilingan saqich asosiy mahsulot bo'lgan. 1893 yilda Juicy Fruit va Spearmint chiqqan.

Sizning biznesingizda qaysi kichik narsa katta ish berdi? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). Britannica 'William Wrigley, Jr.' and Encyclopedia.com (came to Chicago from Philadelphia in 1891 with $32 to sell Wrigley's Scouring Soap; baking powder offered as a premium, outsold the soap; chewing gum then offered as a premium to baking powder buyers, outsold the powder, soap and powder dropped); Wikipedia 'Wrigley Company' and 'Juicy Fruit' (Juicy Fruit and Spearmint introduced 1893); Encyclopedia of Chicago. Sources differ on whether the gum premium began 1891 or 1892, and the text does not give that year.
